drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our proposed revisions to the mutual NDA. We have clarified the confidentiality and permitted-use obligations, added customary exclusions and compelled-disclosure provisions, and addressed return or destruction of materials and survival. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and propose a mutually acceptable governing law and forum.

edits.text: 1. PURPOSE. The parties wish to evaluate a potential transaction (the “Purpose”). Neither party is obligated to disclose information or proceed with any transaction, and no transaction obligation arises unless and until a definitive agreement is executed.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of either party to the other in connection with the Purpose, in any form, including analyses derived from that information and the existence, status and terms of discussions. The receiving party shall use Confidential Information solely for the Purpose, protect it with at least reasonable care, and disclose it only to its directors, officers, employees and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality duties at least as protective as this Agreement. The receiving party is responsible for breaches by those representatives. Confidential Information excludes information the receiving party can demonstrate was lawfully known to it without restriction before disclosure, becomes public without breach of this Agreement, is lawfully received from a third party without a confidentiality duty, or is independently developed without use of Confidential Information. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving party shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt prior notice and reasonable cooperation, at the disclosing party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment, and disclose only what is legally required. Upon written request, the receiving party shall promptly return or destroy Confidential Information, except copies required by law or retained in routine automated backups, which remain subject to this Agreement and may not be used for any other purpose.

3. TERM. This Agreement takes effect on the date of the last signature and remains in effect for twenty-four months. Confidentiality and use restrictions survive expiration for three years; for information constituting a trade secret, those restrictions continue for so long as it qualifies as a trade secret under applicable law.

4. REMEDIES. Each party acknowledges that unauthorized use or disclosure of Confidential Information may cause irreparable harm for which damages may be inadequate. The disclosing party may seek injunctive or other equitable relief, subject to applicable law, in addition to any other available remedies.

We propose New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in state and federal courts in Manhattan, while preserving either party’s ability to seek urgent protective relief in any court of competent jurisdiction; the remaining provisions are acceptable in principle, subject to agreement on the complete document.
